title: Fema / RBI | RBI Notification on UNSC 1267/1989 ISIL (Da’esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Amendment of 2 Entries
description: RBI directs regulated entities to implement updates to the UNSC 1267/1989 ISIL (Da’esh) and Al-Qaida Sanctions List under Section 51A of UAPA, 1967, following amendments to two individual entries.The post RBI Notification on UNSC 1267/1989 ISIL (Da’esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Amendment of 2 Entries appeared first on TaxGuru.
